title: How Horner, Brown and Wolff made their fortunes from F1
paragraphs: Christian Horner, Zak Brown and Toto Wolff have been three of the most influential team bosses during Formula 1's extraordinary growth over the past decade. All three have been very well rewarded for it. But the latest set of F1 team accounts filed in the UK reveal something more interesting than simply how much each has made.

title: INSIGHT: How F1 teams create special one-off liveries
paragraphs: Ahead of the VF-26 running on track at the Circuit of The Americas, we caught up with the team to take a look at how a one-off livery on an F1 car comes to life. “Whenever we look at brand collaborations it has to be a cultural fit with who we are as a team,” explains Francois Puentes, Motorsport Partnerships and Marketing Leader at Haas .
